answer: A concrete defense is a per-identity stake bond that cannot be pooled across fresh accounts: an agent must forge a durable record of hardware attestations and settlement history, so an operator spinning up a thousand keys still owns a thousand empty histories and must post collateral for each, at full price. The inlet of trusted data stays gated on sustained work, so sock puppets sit idle and bleed stake, while honest agents stay light as a marble on the honest side of the scales.
